resources.string: ErsatzTV / HDHomeRun playlists in Live TV. OK on a playlist edits it. Use Channel settings to enable rows in Live TV.
No playlists yet. Press Add playlist to scan the LAN or type a host.
Scan the LAN for ErsatzTV / HDHomeRun, or type a host and optional EPG URL.
Scan, or enter a host, then Save playlist.
Change the host or EPG URL, save, or remove this playlist (and its Live TV channels).
Edit the fields, then Save playlist. Remove also clears its channels.
XMLTV / EPG URL (optional; ErsatzTV auto, HDHomeRun uses SiliconDust)
OK a playlist to edit it, or Add a new one. Sync pushes channels into Live TV.
Synced %1$d channels (%2$d guide rows). Use Channel settings if Live TV is missing them.
Saved %1$s (%2$d channels). Sync now from the main screen.
Saved %1$s. Removed %2$d old channel(s) — Sync now to pull the new host.
Found %1$d. Pick a host above (or keep the first), set EPG if needed, then Save.
Found %1$d. OK a row to select it, set EPG if needed, then Save.
No HDHomeRun-compatible device answered. Type the host.
Add at least one playlist, then Sync now.
Select a playlist in the list first.
